Coca  Coca Leaves; Hoja de Coca. Profile Coca is the dried leaves of Erythroxylum coca (Bolivian or Hua- nuco leaf) or of E. truxillense (Peruvian or Truxillo leaf) (Eryth- roxylaceae), indigenous to Bolivia and Peru and cultivated in Colombia and Indonesia. Coca leaves contain about 0.7 to 1.5% of total alkaloids, of which cocaine, cinnamyl-cocaine, and α-truxilline are the most impor- tant. Coca was formerly used for its stimulant action and for the relief of gastric pain, nausea, and vomiting, but it has no place in mod- ern medicine. The practice of coca leaf chewing still continues in South America.
